svg.title: TierDecay reference architecture
svg.desc: Agent clients (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Cursor, Gemini CLI, others) reach one deterministic engine through context files, Agent Skills, native rules, an MCP server, the CLI, and a Claude Code plugin; the engine reads versioned Markdown state on every call and appends ledger rows under a lock.
svg.text: One posterior per repository, one deterministic engine, every agent client: native files where a tool reads them, MCP and the CLI where it runs tools.
each client uses the surfaces it supports — README matrix
reads on every call · no cache
